visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, straight brown hair is seated at a wooden table, wearing a beige sleeveless tank top. She holds a smartphone in her left hand, pointing at the screen which displays an Uber user profile with a 4.94 rating. Her facial expression is animated and expressive, with wide eyes and a focused gaze. The background consists of a white brick wall and a grey sofa adorned with a bright orange square pillow. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting her features and the device. (2) The video transitions to a screen-captured interface of the Uber mobile application. The sequence shows a step-by-step navigation through the app's menus, including tapping on the 'Account' icon, scrolling through 'Settings', 'Privacy', and 'Privacy Center'. The UI is clean, with various icons representing services like rides and food delivery. Blue highlights and simulated taps guide the viewer's eye through the technical process of accessing the hidden rating details. (3) The scene cuts back to the woman at the table. She continues her explanation, using wide hand gestures to emphasize her points. She looks directly into the camera lens, her mouth moving rapidly as she speaks. Her silver smartwatch is clearly visible on her left wrist as she moves her hands. The indoor domestic setting remains consistent, providing a casual and relatable atmosphere for the tutorial content. (4) A graphic overlay appears over a blurred background. This overlay lists several bullet points with red 'X' marks next to them. The text points describe behaviors like being too noisy or slamming doors. The woman remains partially visible in the corner as the screen focuses on the informational graphic to clearly communicate the reasons for low ratings. The visual presentation is structured like a list, making the information easy to digest for the audience. (5) The final phase shows the woman leaning slightly forward, pointing her index finger down toward the bottom of the frame, indicating the comment section. She maintains a friendly and engaging smile, inviting interaction from the viewers. The camera remains static at an eye-level angle, capturing her upper body. The video ends with her looking expectantly at the viewer, concluding the educational and social narrative.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 搭 Uber 竟然也會被司機評分. [Variety]: 我竟然才 4.94 欸. (2) [Subtitle]: 教你怎麼看自己有幾個差評. (3) [Slogan]: 首先打開 Uber App. (4) [Slogan]: 點右下角的帳戶. (5) [Slogan]: 往下滑選擇設定. (6) [Slogan]: 之後按隱私設定. (7) [Slogan]: 接著點查看摘要. (8) [Slogan]: 再往下滑看到評分. (9) [Slogan]: 然後是檢視. (10) [Slogan]: 就可以找到不同司機對你的個別評分囉. [Variety]: 藏好深!. (11) [Subtitle]: 是不是很納悶為什麼好好搭車卻還會被評低分. (12) [Subtitle]: 根據一些網友們的經驗來看啊. (13) [Variety]: 太吵. [Variety]: 用力關車門. [Variety]: 讓司機等太久. [Variety]: 沒繫安全帶. (14) [Subtitle]: 都有可能是被評低分的原因喔. (15) [Subtitle]: 聽說不可能有人滿分. (16) [Subtitle]: 而且 4.7 左右就算低. (17) [Subtitle]: 4.6 左右還會影響司機的接單意願. (18) [Subtitle]: 留言說說你幾分.
